text: A skincare brand's new advertising campaign leans heavily on social proof to drive conversions. The campaign's landing page prominently displays the tagline "Join the 2 million women who have already made the switch" alongside a real-time counter of purchases. Customer testimonials are organized under a banner reading "The world's most trusted skincare brand" with the subtext: "When this many women choose the same product, it is not marketing. It is proof." Dermatologists interviewed for a consumer report noted that popularity is not a substitute for clinical evidence and that the product's key ingredient has limited peer-reviewed research supporting its advertised benefits.

annotations.quote: When this many women choose the same product, it is not marketing. It is proof.
